$comment: Maintainer-reviewed equivalent mutants for the changed-code mutation gate. Each entry accepts exactly one mutant (file, start line, mutator name, replacement) as equivalent, with the review rationale. Entries are validated against the checked-in source before mutation testing; a missing file, unknown mutator, or line that no longer contains the named mutator fails the gate. Entries that do not match a reported mutant produce advisories for the tested files. Add entries only with maintainer approval; never add in-source Stryker directives. Lines are Stryker report lines (0-based): the editor shows the code at line + 1.
